# Docs sync rules

A change is **not done** until every document that describes the changed thing is true again.
Update them **in the same commit/PR** as the change - never "docs later", never a TODO.

## Before you finish (and in every review)
1. List the files you changed (`git status --short`).
2. Walk the table below for each of them and update every target that applies.
3. When unsure whether something else mentions it, search:
   `grep -rn "<identifier, command, port, path>" README*.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md docs .agents .github`
4. If an English document you touched has translations, update them too (language rule).

## What to update

| If you change | Also update |
|---|---|
| Public API in `src/asyncopation` (`aobjects`, `aq`, `afetch`, `async_atomic`, `asyncopation.testing`) | `README.md` usage, `docs/architecture.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased); ADR if the shape changes |
| A package/layer in `src/` (new, moved, renamed) | `docs/architecture.md` layer table, `[tool.importlinter]` in `pyproject.toml`, `.agents/rules/architecture.md` |
| Use or port of a Django internal | `docs/django-api-ledger.toml` (+ attribution header in code) |
| A design decision or a deviation from the plan | `docs/adr/` (new or superseding ADR), `docs/design/plan.md` |
| Progress on a roadmap item | checklist in `docs/design/plan.md` (and `plan-KO.md`); PR body `Closes #N`; the GitHub milestone |
| Guard codes in `tools/guards` | the module docstring, the matching `.agents/rules/*.md`, `architecture-guard` skill, `docs/workflow.md` enforcement table |
| Hooks (`tools/hooks`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.codex/hooks.json`, `.pi/extensions/`) | `docs/workflow.md` section 1, `CLAUDE.md`, agent notes in `AGENTS.md` |
| `.agents/` rules, skills or sub-agents | `make agents-sync`; the tables in `docs/workflow.md` when one is added, removed or renamed |
| `Makefile` targets or day-to-day commands | `AGENTS.md` commands table, `README.md` development section, skills that quote the command |
| `docker-compose.yml` services/ports, env vars in `harness/settings.py` | `test-db` skill, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `bench/run.py` |
| `harness/catalog` models or `harness/seed.py` sizes | `EXPECTED_COUNTS`, a new migration (`makemigrations catalog`), strategies in `tests/support/strategies.py` |
| Scenarios in `harness/site` or `bench/k6` | all three variants (`/sync`, `/core`, `/aopt`), `perf-bench` and `e2e-harness` skills |
| Dependencies, Python or Django versions | `README.md` requirements, `pyproject.toml` classifiers, CI matrix, ledger `verified_against` |
| `.github/workflows/` or the branch flow | `docs/workflow.md`, `commit` skill |
| An English document that has `-XX` translations | the translation + `uv run python -m tools.guards i18n-stamp <file>` |

## Reviewers
`arch-guardian` reports missing doc updates as **MAJOR** findings (docs drift), with the
document and the stale statement.
